parsed.answer: I couldn't find a past ticket that reports this same problem. The closest is terminal#17836, which has the same Windows.UI.Xaml.dll / 0xc000027b fault signature. However, that crash happened when clicking a scrollbar mark, and the ticket never reached a diagnosis or fix. Exception 0xc000027b is a generic XAML stowed exception that many different bugs can produce, so the matching code alone doesn't show a duplicate. The older selection crashes (terminal#1312, terminal#5983, terminal#2986) have different faulting modules and are from much older versions. Please keep this as a new report. Reproduce the crash with the Feedback Hub's "Start recording" button (category Apps > Windows Terminal) and post the aka.ms link here so the team can find the crash dump. Also mention the exact steps: maximized window, `wsl -d Debian`, then mouse-down at the far left edge. It would also help to say whether the crash happens in a non-maximized window or in a plain PowerShell tab without WSL.
